Keep FOUR existing operators further forward unchanged. Exactly FOUR player operators plus ONE cargo carriage.
Fifth bottom card: crate portrait labeled "짐칸", just ONE cyan carriageHP row with carriage icon. Remove personHP green row, energy/charge row and percentage, and lightning skill icon/button completely from this fifth card. Its remaining bottom area is a plain inactive metal plate, not a hidden button. Never remove any of the three rows/skill buttons from first FOUR cards.
Keep shared legend person/요원HP, railcar/객차HP, energy/충전. Preserve all camera, rail, train positions, full-brass high-quality art, forwardrock, topwholetrainHP4200/5000, ALL original rail-cylinder/control center display, verticalspeed and 3 support buttons. No other edits, no new counters, no extra operator, no turret. Entire 9:16 illustration.
